title: Postgres lifecycle
text: The local engine uses the pinned embedded PostgreSQL binaries and an owner-private Unix socket on macOS, Linux and the native Windows candidate. It opens no TCP port. Windows selects .exe tools and pg_ctl drops admin privileges; extracted binaries must grant the user access directly. Helper output goes to files so a detached postmaster cannot hold captured pipes open. Spaced profile paths use quoted DSNs and server options, with a short private socket directory when needed. Native Windows support awaits the integrated acceptance proof.
